title: Hosanna, Loud Hosanna
description: Hosanna, Loud Hosanna in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Jeanette Threlfall, first published in 1873. The tune, ELLACOMBE, is from Gesangbuch der Herzogl. Hofkapelle, Wurttemberg, 1784. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Ho-san-na,_ loud ho-san_-na, the lit_-tle child-ren sang; Through pil-lared_ court and tem_-ple the love_-ly an-them rang. To_ Je-sus, Who had blessed__ them close_ fold-ed to His breast, The child-ren_ sang their prais_-es, the simp_-lest and the best.

lines: To Jesus, Who had blessed them
The Lord of men and angels
the Lord of heav'n our King.
O may we ever praise Him
with heart and life and voice,

topics: Children (see also God's Children - the Faithful)
licence: Public domain. The Open Hymnal Project marks this hymn “copyright: public domain” (words, music and setting), and places its own editing, indexes and data files in the public domain.
